parameters.query:
SELECT
  s.id AS schedule_id,
  s.next_due_date,
  s.inspection_type,
  s.assigned_inspector_id,
  e.id AS equipment_id,
  e.serial_number,
  e.model_number,
  e.equipment_type,
  f.id AS facility_id,
  f.name AS facility_name,
  fa.email AS admin_email,
  fa.full_name AS admin_name,
  ins.email AS inspector_email,
  ins.phone AS inspector_phone,
  ins.full_name AS inspector_name,
  (CURRENT_DATE - s.next_due_date) AS days_overdue
FROM zipsafe.inspection_schedules s
JOIN zipsafe.equipment e ON e.id = s.equipment_id
JOIN zipsafe.facilities f ON f.id = e.facility_id
JOIN zipsafe.facility_admins fa ON fa.facility_id = f.id AND fa.is_primary = TRUE
LEFT JOIN zipsafe.users ins ON ins.id = s.assigned_inspector_id
WHERE s.next_due_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND s.status = 'scheduled'
ORDER BY s.next_due_date ASC

parameters.query:
UPDATE zipsafe.inspection_schedules
SET
  status = 'overdue',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Query Overdue Inspections').item.json.schedule_id }}
  AND status = 'scheduled'
RETURNING id, status
